scope: Synthetic uniform Schur windows, noncommuting variable skew transport, and runner controls only
cell_family: H(x)=Q diag(d+x*v) Q^T, x in [-width,width]; same Q,d as S0a, v_i=(-1)^i/4. V=Q(I+E)S, E_ij=((i mod 3)-1)*((j mod 5)-2)/(128*n), S_jj=1+(1+(j mod 3))/1024. This exact rational V is not an eigenbasis.
block_rule: For each shift select the two exact center eigenvalue labels nearest below it and two nearest above it, ties by original index. This prescribed synthetic selector is not a physical eigensolver.
transport_family: Repeat 4-by-4 blocks: U(t,x)=R01(20*t+t^2/2+x*t) R12(3*t^2/2), fourth coordinate fixed, t in [0,1], x in [-strip,strip]. A=U_t U^T. Midpoint-frozen exponential steps; additive error debit L*h^2*||center||_F/4 with L=130, plus full rounding and 7*strip*sqrt(2) parameter debit.
interpretation: A job PASS means its declared expected behavior was observed. Expected INCONCLUSIVE is not a certificate. No adaptation of precision, cases, method or thresholds follows outcomes.
